name: elevate
description: ELEVATE — Personal Development & Fashion Style Management Platform

scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.server:build: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && node prisma/seed.js
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma migrate reset
